page: Microsoft Azure EC96iads_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance belonging to the ECIADSv5 family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 7.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type includes 3686 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. It does not include any graphics processing units. The isolated nature of the hardware ensures that the instance runs on dedicated physical hardware, minimizing multi-tenant interference and providing high resource security.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local SSD capacity, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database deployments, and enterprise applications. The qualitative cost efficiency of the EC96iads_v5 is defined by its high resource density and isolated hardware class, which reduces the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances for large-scale data processing.
